description:
The 4StoreyBuilding project is loaded in eQUEST. You are tasked with an equipment consolidation retrofit on the Middle Floor. The goal is to merge the North Zone ('M.N23') onto the East System ('M.E22') and remove the redundant North System.

Expected Actions:
1. Navigate to the Air-Side HVAC module.
2. Locate the Middle Floor North Zone (associated with space 'M.N23'). currently served by system 'M.N23'.
3. Reassign/Move this Zone so it is served by the Middle Floor East System ('M.E22'). System 'M.E22' should now serve both the 'M.E22' zone and the 'M.N23' zone.
4. Delete the original Middle Floor North System ('M.N23') which should now be empty.
5. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to verify the configuration.
6. Save the project.

Note: You must manipulate the project tree structure. Do not simply rename items.
